body:
Similarly to #20839, we seem to misreport diagnostics for `--exact` and `--inexact` as `--inexact` and `--no-inexact`. See below.

---

the assert only catches the `no-` prefix, but the other way to get a wrong name here is a pair that isn't `--x`/`--no-x` at all: `flag(exact, inexact, "inexact")` in uv/src/settings.rs (3 call sites) renders "`--inexact` and `--no-inexact` cannot be used together", and there is no `--no-inexact` — the pair is `--exact`/`--inexact` (`no-exact` is an alias on `inexact`). worth passing "exact" there too while you're in here?

_Originally posted by @Sanjays2402 in https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/20839#discussion_r3685755641_
title: conflicting `--exact` and `--inexact` flag diagnostics are incorrect
